# Radio Venus

> An astrological music discovery tool. Enter your birthday, find where Venus was when you were born, and hear music from artists who share your Venus sign placement.

## What this is

Radio Venus maps musicians by their natal Venus position — the astrological placement that governs aesthetic sensibility, beauty, and taste. Users enter their date of birth, the app calculates their Venus sign using astronomical ephemeris data, and returns a curated stream of musicians who share the same placement. Music is served via YouTube embeds.

## How it works

- User inputs date of birth
- App calculates Venus position (sign, degree, decan) using astronomy-engine
- Matches against a curated database of ~730 musicians with verified birth data
- Artists are ranked by Venus proximity: same decan = highest match, same sign = high, same element/modality = moderate
- User can filter by musical genre/subgenre
- Returns matched musicians as an infinite radio stream via YouTube embeds
- An interactive nebula visualization shows all artists as stars — proximity to center = Venus similarity

## Artist pages

Every artist has a shareable page at `/artist/[slug]/` with Open Graph tags. Sharing from a specific genre playlist generates a genre-specific card at `/artist/[slug]/[genre]/` — so two people sharing the same artist from different genre contexts get different cards.

## Genre and sign pages

- `/sign/[sign]/` — all artists for a Venus sign (e.g. `/sign/scorpio/`)
- `/sign/[sign]/[genre]/` — filtered by genre within a sign
- `/about/` — full artist roster and site stats
- Sitemap: https://radio-venus.club/sitemap.xml (~830 URLs)

## Astrological premise

In natal astrology, Venus signifies what a person finds beautiful, pleasurable, and aesthetically valuable. Each of the 12 zodiac signs gives Venus a distinct aesthetic character:

- Venus in Aries: raw, impulsive, punk energy
- Venus in Taurus: lush, sensual, textural richness
- Venus in Gemini: intellectual, genre-blending, witty
- Venus in Cancer: nostalgic, intimate, confessional
- Venus in Leo: dramatic, theatrical, radiant
- Venus in Virgo: precise, craft-oriented, understated
- Venus in Libra: harmonious, elegant, balanced
- Venus in Scorpio: intense, underground, transformative
- Venus in Sagittarius: expansive, world-music, eclectic
- Venus in Capricorn: structured, austere, timeless
- Venus in Aquarius: experimental, futuristic, avant-garde
- Venus in Pisces: ethereal, ambient, devotional
